Thagon ka ustad khud ban gaya shikar - Bluffmaster Full Movie 4K - Nana Patekar, Ritesh Deshmukh
Thagi karne vala roy dohri zindgi jita hai, apni garlaphrend simmi ko yakin dilata hai ki vah ek sadharan, eemandar larka hai. halanki, jab use sachchaee ka pata chalta hai, to vah apne rishte ko bachane men asmarth ho jata hai. sarak par girne ke bad, roy ko pata chalta hai ki use bren tyumar hai aur ab uske pas jine ke lie zyada samay nahin hai. isse pahle ki bahut der ho jae, uska sathi aur shishy dittu roy ko ek aakhiri mastar plan men hissa lene ke lie mana leta hai.
Nirdeshak - rohan sippi
